source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 6
statement: Revocations are frozen within the major version (RFC 0014 R6, SNP-26): a revocation not read is a token accepted again, so what either version writes, the other reads.
guards: compat:CredentialCompatTest#a revocation either version writes, the other reads
